title: Hand of Straights
statement_md:
Alice has an integer array `hand` of cards and an integer `groupSize`. She wants to rearrange the cards into groups so that each group has size `groupSize` and consists of `groupSize` consecutive cards. Return `true` if she can rearrange the cards, or `false` otherwise.

**Function:** `isNStraightHand(hand, groupSize)`

**Input:** one JSON value per parameter, in the order above. **Output:** the returned value as JSON.
hints: Ask which choice is safe to make right now and never needs to be undone.
Sorting by the right key often reveals the greedy order.
Data structure: a sorted list, or a heap (heapq) to repeatedly get the smallest or largest item.
